# threepipe examples

> threepipe is a 3D web framework built on three.js. Load a model, add plugins, render. It covers rendering, materials,
> post-processing, importers and exporters, UI and editors. Each folder here is a small working example of one feature.

## Use threepipe

`npm install threepipe`, or start a project with `npm create threepipe@latest`, or load it from a CDN:

```html
<canvas id="canvas" style="width: 800px; height: 600px"></canvas>
<script type="module">
  import {ThreeViewer} from 'https://unpkg.com/threepipe@latest/dist/index.mjs'
  const viewer = new ThreeViewer({canvas: document.getElementById('canvas')})
  viewer.setEnvironmentMap('https://samples.threepipe.org/minimal/venice_sunset_1k.hdr')
  viewer.load('https://threejs.org/examples/models/gltf/DamagedHelmet/glTF/DamagedHelmet.gltf', {autoCenter: true, autoScale: true})
</script>
```

## Get the source

Pages are at `https://threepipe.org/examples/<name>/`; use `dev` for `master` below for the latest, unreleased version.

- One example: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/repalash/threepipe/master/examples/<name>/index.html`, and `script.ts` next
  to it (or the file its `data-scripts` attribute names). The import map in `index.html` lists the packages it uses.
- List all examples: `https://api.github.com/repos/repalash/threepipe/contents/examples?ref=master`
- All of threepipe: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/repalash/threepipe`, or `npm install threepipe`, which also has `src/`.

## Read more

- Guide: https://threepipe.org/guide/getting-started.html
- A plugin: `https://threepipe.org/plugin/<PluginName>.html`; a package: `https://threepipe.org/package/<name>.html`
- API reference: https://threepipe.org/docs/

## What you can do

Read an example, then use the same plugins and APIs in your own project rather than writing them again in plain three.js.
threepipe is Apache-2.0. Models and textures that examples load may have their own licenses.
